HOST_REPLY_CODES.doc: The refusals the verbs of this package answer, by the number of resp <n>: mod-host's own numbers (mod-host.h) and the ones a worker answers past them.

instanceInvalid.doc: mod-host's ERR_INSTANCE_INVALID: an instance number outside the host's table

instanceNonExists.doc: mod-host's ERR_INSTANCE_NON_EXISTS: an instance no add made

paramSymbolInvalid.doc: mod-host's ERR_LV2_INVALID_PARAM_SYMBOL: a symbol that is not a parameter param_set takes, the plugin's own bypass included

memoryAllocation.doc: mod-host's ERR_MEMORY_ALLOCATION: the reply could not be built

invalidOperation.doc: mod-host's ERR_INVALID_OPERATION: a word outside the verb's grammar, or a verb the host refuses on purpose

pinAbsent.doc: a layout pin in a scheme this host does not know, refused as no pin at all

pinLayoutMismatch.doc: the add of an instance whose layout after init is not the one pin_expect named: the plugin is not activated

noParamContract.doc: the host holds no checked unit and scale for this parameter: the controller falls back to the layout the scan gives

noNoteInput.doc: the instance's plugin takes no notes

notesByJack.doc: the instance's worker takes no notes on its socket (mod-host): the plugin is played through its jack MIDI input

noteQueueFull.doc: the worker has no room for the line's notes before its next block: nothing of it is kept, and the line may be sent again

HOST_TRACK_KINDS.doc: The kind of strip, the last word of track_info; a line without it is an input channel.

HOST_EVENTS.doc: The lines a host writes on its feedback port for these verbs, each followed by the instance number.

remotePagesChanged.doc: the plugin changed its remote pages: a controller reads remote_pages and remote_page_get again

OMX_CLAP_CORE_SHARED_VERBS.doc: The verbs omx-clap-host and plugin-hostd both answer by instance, and the layout pin plugin-hostd sends its worker before an add: declared once, rendered for both hosts.

trackInfo.doc: The strip's name, colour and kind: <instance> <name> <#RRGGBB | -> [bus | return | master]; a string word is at most 255 bytes of UTF-8 with no control character, and any other word is -902. A CLAP plugin reads them through clap.track-info.

remotePages.doc: The plugin's remote-control pages, from clap.remote-controls; 0 for a plugin that has none.

remotePageGet.doc: One page, 0 to count - 1: its section and name as quoted words, and each slot the symbol param_set takes, - for an empty one; -902 for a page that is not one.

paramInfo.doc: What a parameter's value means: its unit, its scale (linear, log or stepped), its range, default and step, and the symbol it keeps across hosts and versions.

pinExpect.doc: The layout pin <scheme>:<sha256> the next add of the instance checks after init and before activate; plugin-hostd sends it to a worker of a format that checks layouts, and refuses the add with any other answer than resp 0.

noteInput.doc: Whether the instance takes notes: the name of its note input on its worker's jack client, - for a plugin that takes none.

noteOn.doc: Play a key: <instance> <channel> <key> <velocity>, channel 0 to 15, key 0 to 127, velocity 1 to 127, a MIDI note on at the start of the worker's next cycle; -902 for a word out of its range.

noteOff.doc: Release a key: <instance> <channel> <key> <velocity>, velocity 0 to 127, a MIDI note off; answered as note_on is.

allNotesOff.doc: Release every key of every channel, MIDI's all notes off (controller 123) on each; answered as note_on is.

OMX_CLAP_HOST_VERBS.doc: The verbs omx-clap-host adds to mod-host's protocol for itself: what a controller reads of an instance's ports, window, note counters and the CPU idle hold.

audioPorts.doc: The instance's audio ports, inputs first and each side's main port first, each with the JACK ports that carry it; dry while the instance passes its input through.

hideExternalUi.doc: Hide the plugin's own window that show_external_ui showed.

idleHold.doc: The CPU idle hold as it stands; idle_hold <off | microseconds> changes its target at once and answers resp 0.

noteDrops.doc: The note events the instance's blocks had no room for, of them the releases, the sysex past a block's pool, and the messages no dialect of the plugin carries.

noteOutDrops.doc: The plugin's note output counters: the events the ring had no room for, those with no MIDI form, and the messages midi_out had no room for.
